Pricing section written to `build-output/`. Nothing was run or rendered, because Bash is disabled in this session. I did check the CSS custom properties I used against `src/styles/tokens.css`, but I did not check the `font:` shorthand tokens or the `StatusPill` info tone.

- `build-output/PricingSection.jsx` — Studio, Team and Enterprise as data-driven plan cards. Each has a name, price, feature list and one button.
- `build-output/PricingSection.module.css` — layout and type, using tokens only (no raw hex or px).

**Design system parts used**
- **Card:** flat variant, from `src/components/Card/Card.jsx`.
- **Button:** primary on the recommended plan, secondary on the others.
- **PlusBullet:** list bullets, teal on the recommended plan only.
- **StatusPill:** the "Recommended" label.

**Recommended plan (Team)**
- It gets a "Recommended" pill, a raised ground and the primary button, so colour never carries the meaning alone.
- On 768px and up it takes a wider middle column (1 / 1.25 / 1), which avoids a symmetric card grid.
- Below 768px it is one column with Team first.
- No borders or shadows.

**Open points**
- Prices, features and button labels are placeholders.
- I did not use `HeadingRule` or the `glass` Card variant. Glass needs a real backdrop behind it.
- Imports use `../src/components/...`, so the build only resolves from the repo root layout.

Left undone

  - Check the layout at 390, 768 and 1024px.
  - Check hover, focus, keyboard and reduced-motion behaviour.
- *Waiting on Levi:*
  - Send real plan copy and prices.
